brief: Compare a proposed restructuring using total cost, term and payment feasibility.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Read the whole replacement plan"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee el plan nuevo completo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia o novo plano inteiro"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare a proposed restructuring using total cost, term and payment feasibility.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A replacement schedule changes payment size, duration and possibly total cost.
instruction.misconception: Treating a smaller revised installment as proof of lower total cost or guaranteed affordability.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: A smaller installment can last longer and cost more overall. Compare total payments, fees, duration and your actual payment capacity.
The replacement produces a larger remaining total here.
18 × 30 = 540; included fees are not added again.
Installment size alone does not reveal total repayment.
A lower total can still have an unaffordable payment date.
New collateral changes consequences even when installment size falls.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
